user.title: Ring Keypad (1st Gen)
user.description: Pick the Ring Gen 1 keypad (already paired to Z-Wave JS) and the alarm panel it should control.

error.device_not_found: That device could not be found.

abort.already_configured: This keypad is already set up.

data_description.silent_status: Show the mode lights without keypad sounds (adds 32). Does not affect the alarm sound.
data_description.code_timeout: How long a code typed before a mode button stays valid.
data_description.ind_arming: Best guess: 23 shows a red countdown animation. -1 skips this state.
data_description.ind_pending: Best guess: 8 blinks red with beeps. -1 skips this state.

set_indicator.name: Set indicator
set_indicator.description: Send a raw Indicator value (0–63) to the keypad.

value.name: Value
value.description: Low 4 bits pick the lights, +16 changes the sound, +32 mutes.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Play a chime on the keypad (e.g. when a door opens). The alarm-state lights are restored afterwards.

value.name: Chime
value.description: 15 = door chime. Other values can be tried.
